title: सप्तनवत्यधिकशततमोऽध्यायः

summary.en: Yudhishthira likewise sends out his army, led by Dhrishtadyumna, Bhima, Arjuna and the other heroes, arranging his forces to confuse Dhritarashtra's spies. Thousands of drums and conches sound as the Pandava host advances towards Kurukshetra.
summary.kn: ಯುಧಿಷ್ಠಿರನೂ ಧೃಷ್ಟದ್ಯುಮ್ನ, ಭೀಮ, ಅರ್ಜುನ ಮೊದಲಾದ ವೀರರ ನೇತೃತ್ವದಲ್ಲಿ ಸೈನ್ಯ ಕಳುಹಿಸಿ ಧೃತರಾಷ್ಟ್ರನ ಗೂಢಚಾರರನ್ನು ಗೊಂದಲಗೊಳಿಸುವಂತೆ ಪಡೆಗಳನ್ನು ಜೋಡಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಸಾವಿರಾರು ಭೇರಿ ಶಂಖಗಳು ಮೊಳಗುವಾಗ ಪಾಂಡವಸೈನ್ಯ ಕುರುಕ್ಷೇತ್ರದತ್ತ ಮುನ್ನುಗ್ಗುತ್ತದೆ.
summary.hi: युधिष्ठिर भी धृष्टद्युम्न, भीम, अर्जुन और अन्य वीरों के नेतृत्व में अपनी सेना भेजते हैं, और धृतराष्ट्र के गुप्तचरों को भ्रमित करने के लिए अपनी सेनाओं को सजाते हैं। हज़ारों नगाड़े और शंख बजते हैं और पाण्डव सेना कुरुक्षेत्र की ओर बढ़ती है।
summary.te: యుధిష్ఠిరుడు కూడా ధృష్టద్యుమ్నుడు, భీముడు, అర్జునుడు మొదలైన వీరుల నాయకత్వంలో సైన్యాన్ని పంపి, ధృతరాష్ట్రుని గూఢచారులను తికమకపెట్టేలా దళాలను అమర్చుతాడు. వేలాది భేరీలు, శంఖాలు మోగుతుండగా పాండవసైన్యం కురుక్షేత్రం వైపు సాగుతుంది.
summary.ta: யுதிஷ்டிரரும் த்ருஷ்டத்யும்னன், பீமன், அர்ஜுனன் முதலிய வீரர்கள் தலைமையில் தம் படையை அனுப்பி, த்ருதராஷ்டிரனின் ஒற்றர்களைக் குழப்பும்படி படைகளை அமைக்கிறார். ஆயிரக்கணக்கான முரசுகளும் சங்குகளும் முழங்கப் பாண்டவப் படை குருக்ஷேத்திரத்தை நோக்கி முன்னேறுகிறது.
summary.ml: യുധിഷ്ഠിരനും തന്റെ സേനയെ പുറപ്പെടുവിക്കുന്നു; ധൃഷ്ടദ്യുമ്നൻ, ഭീമൻ, അർജുനൻ മറ്റു വീരന്മാർ എന്നിവരുടെ നേതൃത്വത്തിൽ, ധൃതരാഷ്ട്രരുടെ ചാരന്മാരെ കുഴക്കാൻ സൈന്യത്തെ ക്രമീകരിക്കുന്നു. ആയിരക്കണക്കിന് ഭേരികളും ശംഖുകളും മുഴങ്ങുമ്പോൾ പാണ്ഡവസേന കുരുക്ഷേത്രത്തിലേക്ക് മുന്നേറുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 5.197; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Tue Jan 23 2024

verses.text: वैशंपायन उवाच

meaning.en: Vaishampayana said:

verses.text:
तथैव राजा कौन्तेयो धर्मपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः ।
धृष्टद्युम्नमुखान्वीरांश्चोदयामास भारत ॥

meaning.en: In the same way, King Yudhishthira, Kunti's son and the son of Dharma, set the heroes in motion, with Dhrishtadyumna at their head, O Bharata.

verses.text:
चेदिकाशिकरूषाणां नेतारं दृढविक्रमम् ।
सेनापतिममित्रघ्नं धृष्टकेतुमथादिशत् ॥

meaning.en: He appointed Dhrishtaketu, the firm-valiant destroyer of foes, leader of the Chedis, Kashis and Karushas, as commander.

verses.text:
विराटं द्रुपदं चैव युयुधानं शिखण्डिनम् ।
पाञ्चाल्यौ च महेष्वासौ युधामन्यूत्तमौजसौ ॥

meaning.en: He sent Virata, Drupada, Yuyudhana, Shikhandin, and the two great archers of Panchala, Yudhamanyu and Uttamaujas.

verses.text:
ते शूराश्चित्रवर्माणस्तप्तकुण्डलधारिणः ।
आज्यावसिक्ता ज्वलिता धिष्ण्येष्विव हुताशनाः ।
अशोभन्त महेष्वासा ग्रहाः प्रज्वलिता इव ॥

meaning.en: Those heroes, in brightly colored armor, wearing burnished earrings, shone as great archers like blazing planets, or like sacrificial fires on their altars fed with ghee.

verses.text:
सोऽथ सैन्यं यथायोगं पूजयित्वा नरर्षभः ।
दिदेश तान्यनीकानि प्रयाणाय महीपतिः ॥

meaning.en: Then that bull among men, the king, having honored the army as was fitting, ordered those divisions to march.

verses.text:
अभिमन्युं बृहन्तं च द्रौपदेयांश्च सर्वशः ।
धृष्टद्युम्नमुखानेतान्प्राहिणोत्पाण्डुनन्दनः ॥

meaning.en: Abhimanyu, Brihanta and all the sons of Draupadi, headed by Dhrishtadyumna, were sent forward by the son of Pandu.

verses.text:
भीमं च युयुधानं च पाण्डवं च धनंजयम् ।
द्वितीयं प्रेषयामास बलस्कन्धं युधिष्ठिरः ॥

meaning.en: Yudhishthira sent Bhima, Yuyudhana and the Pandava Dhananjaya as the second mass of troops.

verses.text:
भाण्डं समारोपयतां चरतां संप्रधावताम् ।
हृष्टानां तत्र योधानां शब्दो दिवमिवास्पृशत् ॥

meaning.en: As the joyful warriors loaded up their baggage, moved about and ran here and there, the noise of them rose as if touching the sky.

verses.text:
स्वयमेव ततः पश्चाद्विराटद्रुपदान्वितः ।
तथान्यैः पृथिवीपालैः सह प्रायान्महीपतिः ॥

meaning.en: Then the king himself came after, together with Virata and Drupada and other rulers of the earth.

verses.text:
भीमधन्वायनी सेना धृष्टद्युम्नपुरस्कृता ।
गङ्गेव पूर्णा स्तिमिता स्यन्दमाना व्यदृश्यत ॥

meaning.en: The Pandava army, with Bhima as its bowman, led by Dhrishtadyumna, looked like the Ganga in flood, full, calm and flowing on.

verses.text:
ततः पुनरनीकानि व्ययोजयत बुद्धिमान् ।
मोहयन्धृतराष्ट्रस्य पुत्राणां बुद्धिनिस्रवम् ॥

meaning.en: Then the wise king again arranged the divisions, confusing the minds of Dhritarashtra's sons, whose thinking was already leaking away.

verses.text:
द्रौपदेयान्महेष्वासानभिमन्युं च पाण्डवः ।
नकुलं सहदेवं च सर्वांश्चैव प्रभद्रकान् ॥

meaning.en: The Pandava appointed the great archers, the sons of Draupadi, Abhimanyu, Nakula, Sahadeva and all the Prabhadrakas.

verses.text:
दश चाश्वसहस्राणि द्विसाहस्रं च दन्तिनः ।
अयुतं च पदातीनां रथाः पञ्चशतास्तथा ॥

meaning.en: There were ten thousand horses, two thousand elephants, ten thousand foot-soldiers and five hundred chariots.

verses.text:
भीमसेनं च दुर्धर्षं प्रथमं प्रादिशद्बलम् ।
मध्यमे तु विराटं च जयत्सेनं च मागधम् ॥

meaning.en: He assigned the unassailable Bhimasena to the first division. In the middle were Virata and Jayatsena of Magadha.

verses.text:
महारथौ च पाञ्चाल्यौ युधामन्यूत्तमौजसौ ।
वीर्यवन्तौ महात्मानौ गदाकार्मुकधारिणौ ।
अन्वयातां ततो मध्ये वासुदेवधनंजयौ ॥

meaning.en: The two mighty Panchala chariot-warriors, Yudhamanyu and Uttamaujas, brave and great-souled, bearing mace and bow, followed; and in the middle were Vasudeva and Dhananjaya.

verses.text:
बभूवुरतिसंरब्धाः कृतप्रहरणा नराः ।
तेषां विंशतिसाहस्रा ध्वजाः शूरैरधिष्ठिताः ॥

meaning.en: The men were thoroughly roused, with their weapons ready. Twenty thousand banners were held aloft by those brave men.

verses.text:
पञ्च नागसहस्राणि रथवंशाश्च सर्वशः ।
पदातयश्च ये शूराः कार्मुकासिगदाधराः ।
सहस्रशोऽन्वयुः पश्चादग्रतश्च सहस्रशः ॥

meaning.en: Five thousand elephants and chariot-lines on every side, and the brave foot-soldiers with bows, swords and maces, followed in thousands, behind and in front.

verses.text:
युधिष्ठिरो यत्र सैन्ये स्वयमेव बलार्णवे ।
तत्र ते पृथिवीपाला भूयिष्ठं पर्यवस्थिताः ॥

meaning.en: In the army where Yudhishthira himself was, in that ocean of strength, the rulers of the earth stood in greatest numbers.

verses.text:
तत्र नागसहस्राणि हयानामयुतानि च ।
तथा रथसहस्राणि पदातीनां च भारत ।
यदाश्रित्याभियुयुधे धार्तराष्ट्रं सुयोधनम् ॥

meaning.en: There were thousands of elephants, tens of thousands of horses, thousands of chariots and foot-soldiers, O Bharata, relying on which he fought against Duryodhana, the son of Dhritarashtra.

verses.text:
ततोऽन्ये शतशः पश्चात्सहस्रायुतशो नराः ।
नदन्तः प्रययुस्तेषामनीकानि सहस्रशः ॥

meaning.en: Then hundreds of other men followed behind, in thousands and tens of thousands, roaring, and their divisions went forward by the thousand.

verses.text:
तत्र भेरीसहस्राणि शङ्खानामयुतानि च ।
वादयन्ति स्म संहृष्टाः सहस्रायुतशो नराः ॥

meaning.en: There, thousands of kettledrums and tens of thousands of conches were sounded by joyful men, in thousands and tens of thousands.
